title: The Lunch Tray
script: Be Nice. Episode four. The lunch tray. Every school has that table. The one where the new kid sits alone. Jasmine noticed him on day one. She didn't make a speech. She set her tray down across from him and said, "Is this seat taken?" That's it. Fifteen years later, he's a teacher. And every September, he watches that table. Somebody sat down for you once. Go sit down for someone. Be nice. See you tomorrow.
quote: Somebody sat down for you once. Go sit down for someone.
